high_level_description: The image is a combination of text and a photograph. The text is an excerpt from an article by celebrity style journalist Tom Fitzgerald of the website Tom & Lorenzo. It discusses an actor's choice of roles and his aspiration to emulate leading men and action stars from the 1990s. The text highlights that the actor is deliberately cultivating a distinct persona, aiming for roles that emphasize his identity as Glen Powell rather than donning a cape and tights, which is typical of superhero movies.
